reports.name: Independent adapter admission and exhaustive Horn replay
reports.scope: 24 routes checked against a separate minimum-cost solver; ordered replay, explicit premise withdrawals, frozen-input mutation and file-boundary checks.

counting_policy: 69 distinct gates once; normal/optimized replays and the initial failed run are not added. Scientific acceptance remains unchanged at 532 checks.

repaired_finding.description: A passed replay was not tied to later frozen bytes, permitting unreviewed changed premises under a previously reviewed rule ID. Complete fingerprints and renewed ledger validation now reject the before/after controls.

result: All 24 supplied route outcomes agree with independent exhaustive derivability and minimum cost. Stability smallness and all-order/asymptotic hypotheses remain necessary; the four-dimensional goal stays underivable.
limitations: Conventional reviewed implications and a finite Horn solver, not a formal mathematics kernel.
The scientific ledger is a trusted source-bound artifact, not a cryptographically authenticated reviewer identity.
Graph-only abstract fixtures do not supply scientific acceptance.
Response report provenance is source-bound; floating ODE results are not promoted to exact trajectory certificates.
